dedupe_keys.name: entise building and energy time series generator

description: EnTiSe is a Python time-series generator maintained by the Technical University of Munich energy systems group. The package creates demand and operating series for buildings and related energy systems, with documented methods for electricity, domestic hot water, heat pumps, HVAC, occupancy, solar PV and wind. Users supply object parameters and weather or other driving data; outputs are summaries and time-indexed series for selected buildings or technologies. Geographic coverage is a user-defined site or portfolio, and the time interval follows the input index. MIT-licensed source, examples and package installation are public. A limitation is that the README also lists mobility, hydroelectricity and several other methods as planned, so they should not be counted as available functions. Synthetic time series need comparison with measured loads before use in an infrastructure capacity study. EnTiSe can supply demand or generation profiles to energy-system simulation. The catalogue's model-energyplus is a distinct building-energy simulator. No example data or package was downloaded.
